name: ELayerResourceState
declaration:
enum ELayerResourceState {
  notOver = 0, // 未超限
  isResourceOver = 1, // 已超限
  isNumberOver = 2,
  isMainResourceOver = 3, // 标识main资源超限
  isCutMoreThanFill = 4, // cut源大于fill源
  isCutResourceOver = 5, // 标识cut源超限
  isLiveBKGNoOutputResourceOver = 7, // LiveBKG不占用输出资源的资源超限（P80）
}
